scope: Evidence-backed differentiators; no first/only or market-exclusivity claim. This index is navigation, not new execution evidence.

reproduce.expected: 5/5 links hold in text mode; inspect compiler, guard, payment and outcome sections in JSON

claims.title: Typed, reviewable owner policy
claims.claim: Owners express authority in a separate .x3 mandate that can be reviewed and hashed.
claims.evidence_level: local compilation + archived mainnet hash match
claims.limitation: Source hashes identify bytes; Guard does not compile or run .x3 on-chain.

claims.title: Checks outside the model
claims.claim: Compiler and deterministic mandate checks refuse unsafe programs even when a scripted model follows an attack.
claims.limitation: Scripted attacks are not proof of universal prompt-injection resistance or mainnet attack refusals.

claims.title: Policy checks on authenticated quote terms
claims.claim: Guard verifies the 1Click signature and checks quote terms against stored policy before authorizing a deposit address.
claims.evidence_level: archived NEAR mainnet acceptance + historical testnet controls
claims.limitation: Acceptance is not funding or settlement. The forbidden official quote control is a dry quote and also fails dry-quote checks.

claims.title: Source-to-payment traceability
claims.claim: One verifier follows source identity, compiled fields, Guard acceptance, executed transfers and recorded outcome.
claims.evidence_level: local verifier over archived mainnet evidence
claims.limitation: The owner manually funded; provider association is not cryptographic cross-chain atomicity; Guard does not authenticate outcome hashes.

claims.title: Restricted agent authority
claims.claim: The demonstrated signing key is limited to three Guard methods on x3lang.near.
claims.evidence_level: archived NEAR mainnet key and signer observations
claims.limitation: The agent account retains an owner FullAccess recovery key; this is not autonomous custody or control over the Solana funding wallet.

claims.title: Reproducible evidence with explicit boundaries
claims.claim: Judges can rerun local checks, inspect structured receipts and compare original source hashes.
claims.limitation: Offline replay does not refresh chain state, establish production reliability or constitute an independent security audit.
